messages.subject: Instats seminars for lavaan – August 2026
parts:
Hello colleagues

Based on lavaan's published focus on BEWARE ONLY seminars using lavaan in R are allowed: Welcome to the lavaan discussion group. Lavaan is an R package for latent variable analysis, the following upcoming Instats livestreams may be relevant:

Introduction to Dyadic Data Analysis 2.0 with Michael Fitzgerald – Livestream starting August 12
This three-day workshop delves into dyadic data analysis using Structural Equation Modelings in R (lavaan), equipping participants with the skills to analyze paired interactions and complex relational dynamics.


Best wishes

Michael Zyphur
Professor and Director
